bullets.text: YouTube Meets Retro TV - Channel Surfer mimics old-school cable TV for YouTube browsing.
Claude's Visuals Upgrade - Anthropic's Claude can now generate interactive charts and diagrams in chats.
MacBook Neo Impresses - Apple's new MacBook Neo is praised for its build quality and affordability.
AirTag 2 Enhancements - New features include Precision Finding on Apple Watch, enhancing lost item recovery.
Truecaller Fights Scammers - New feature allows family members to manage scam calls for each other.
Tesla Enters UK Utility Market - Tesla becomes a licensed utility, challenging existing energy providers.
Gumloop Secures Major Funding - Startup raises $50M to empower employees to build AI agents.
Meta AI Enhancements - Facebook Marketplace introduces AI auto-replies to streamline seller communications.
Substack's Video Studio Launch - New built-in recording studio simplifies video creation for creators.
Rox AI Valuation Soars - Sales automation startup Rox AI reaches a $1.2B valuation amid growth.
